statement: "If this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead" (and "would be sent from the field to the GY, place it on top of the Deck instead") applies as the card leaves the field, not while it is on it: it applies wherever on the field the card is, a Spell & Trap Zone too (no range), and negating the card's effects on the field doesn't stop it (CANNOT_DISABLE). A monster's is an unclassified effect (UNCLASSIFIED), not a Continuous one.

sources.name: Floowandereeze & Robina
sources.says: ② ("If this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead") is an effect classed as none of Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous (起動効果・誘発効果・誘発即時効果・永続効果のいずれにも分類されない効果です), and makes no chain link. The FAQs of all 8 cards with this sentence say the same (Dark Magician of Chaos 5880, Core of Chaos 18156, Shell of Chaos 18155, Floowandereeze & Toccan 16501, & Eglen 16499, & Stri 16500; read by Claude, 2026-11-22, from db-ygoresources-com/yugioh-faq-history).

While Skill Drain negates its effects on the field, Floowandereeze & Robina that leaves the field is still banished by its ②: it "isn't an effect applied on the field" (フィールドで適用される効果ではありません), so it is banished even if it leaves the field with its effects negated. The same for Kokekokko, Dark Magician of Chaos, Exodios, Core of Chaos, Shell of Chaos and the other Floowandereeze.
Kokekokko face-up in a Spell & Trap Zone is banished when it leaves the field too; the same for Dark Magician of Chaos, Exodios, Core of Chaos, Shell of Chaos and the Floowandereeze.

sources.name: Archlord Kristya
sources.says: ④ ("If this face-up card would be sent from the field to the GY, place it on top of the Deck instead") is an unclassified effect; it applies in the Damage Step, when the card is face-up in a Spell & Trap Zone, and when its effects are negated (効果が無効化されている状態の表側表示のこのカードが墓地へ送られる場合でも適用されます).

scripts: The scripts agree: aux.AddBanishRedirect (utility.lua) and Archlord Kristya's c59509952 register a SINGLE EFFECT_LEAVE_FIELD_REDIRECT, without a range, with EFFECT_FLAG_CANNOT_DISABLE. Kristya's is a LEAVE_FIELD_REDIRECT whose condition checks that the destination is the GY, where RML writes a TO_GRAVE_REDIRECT that applies while the card is face-up on the field.
